newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt $15 million mutual fund fully subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Egypt $15 million mutual fund fully subscribed.

text.p: Egypt's Orient Trust Company (OTC) said on Monday it had closed its 50 million pound ($15 million) equities-based mutual fund after it was fully subscribed.

Financial Analyst Samah Sami told Reuters the capital-accumulation fund closed on January 26 after investors bought the 45,000 units it offered. The OTC kept the remaining 5,000 units, which are priced at 1,000 pounds each.
"We closed it exactly when we got the money because we did not want to get into the business of allocations," Sami said. "We are targeting larger investors with this fund."
Investors had to buy a minimum 10 units.

Unit prices will be calculated each week based on the average changes in the stock prices and dividends paid at the end of the financial year if the unit's capital value exceeds 1,200 pounds, or 20 percent of its value at the time of subscription.
